# Donor Stewardship Workflow Templates

## Template 1: New Donor Welcome Series

### Timeline: First 30 Days

**Day 1-2: Immediate Acknowledgment**
- [ ] Send automated email receipt (within 24 hours)
- [ ] Log donation in CRM
- [ ] Assign donor to stewardship tier

**Day 3-5: Personal Thank You**
- [ ] Mail handwritten thank you note
- [ ] Include impact statement specific to gift amount
- [ ] Add personal signature from relevant team member

**Day 7: Welcome Email**
- [ ] Send welcome series email #1
- [ ] Include organization story/mission
- [ ] Link to impact stories
- [ ] Introduce team members

**Day 14: Impact Update**
- [ ] Welcome series email #2
- [ ] Show how their donation is being used
- [ ] Include photos/videos if available
- [ ] Invite to upcoming event (if applicable)

**Day 30: Engagement Check**
- [ ] Survey or feedback request
- [ ] Offer communication preferences
- [ ] Suggest volunteer opportunities
- [ ] Provide tax receipt information

---

## Template 2: Major Donor Stewardship (Annual)

### Quarterly Touchpoints

**Q1: January-March**
- [ ] Personal call from Development Director
- [ ] Send annual impact report
- [ ] Invite to exclusive donor briefing
- [ ] Share year-end financials

**Q2: April-June**
- [ ] In-person meeting or site visit
- [ ] Mid-year progress update
- [ ] Recognition in newsletter/annual report
- [ ] Birthday/anniversary card

**Q3: July-September**
- [ ] Summer impact story email
- [ ] Invite to special event
- [ ] Update on specific funded project
- [ ] Request feedback/input

**Q4: October-December**
- [ ] Renewal conversation/solicitation
- [ ] Holiday greeting card
- [ ] Year-end giving opportunity
- [ ] Plan next year's engagement

---

## Template 3: Monthly Donor (Sustainer) Journey

### Onboarding (Month 1-3)

**Month 1**
- [ ] Welcome email with sustainer benefits
- [ ] Thank you call from staff member
- [ ] Add to exclusive Facebook/community group
- [ ] Send welcome kit/gift

**Month 2**
- [ ] Behind-the-scenes content email
- [ ] Feature sustainer spotlight (with permission)
- [ ] Provide update on collective impact

**Month 3**
- [ ] Check in on payment processing
- [ ] Send impact report showing cumulative giving
- [ ] Invite to sustainers-only event

### Ongoing (Monthly)
- [ ] Exclusive monthly newsletter
- [ ] Quarterly impact videos
- [ ] Annual sustainer appreciation event
- [ ] Birthday recognition
- [ ] Anniversary milestone gifts (6 mo, 1 yr, etc.)

---

## Template 4: Lapsed Donor Re-engagement

### 60-Day Reactivation Campaign

**Week 1: Soft Touch**
- [ ] Segment lapsed donors by last gift date
- [ ] Send "we miss you" email
- [ ] Include recent impact story
- [ ] No direct ask yet

**Week 2-3: Value Reminder**
- [ ] Mail personalized letter
- [ ] Reference past giving history
- [ ] Show total cumulative impact
- [ ] Include reply card

**Week 4: Phone Outreach**
- [ ] Call to thank for past support
- [ ] Ask about continued interest
- [ ] Listen for feedback/concerns
- [ ] Update contact information

**Week 6: Re-engagement Ask**
- [ ] Send targeted appeal
- [ ] Suggest gift at previous level
- [ ] Offer payment plan option
- [ ] Include multiple ways to give

**Week 8: Final Touch**
- [ ] Send "last chance" communication
- [ ] Offer to adjust communication preferences
- [ ] Provide option to stay connected without giving
- [ ] Mark for future cultivation if no response

---

## Template 5: Event-Based Donor Follow-Up

### Post-Event Timeline

**Day 1: Thank You**
- [ ] Send thank you email to attendees
- [ ] Include event photos
- [ ] Link to donation page

**Day 2-3: Personal Notes**
- [ ] Handwritten notes to VIPs/donors
- [ ] Thank speakers/volunteers
- [ ] Follow up on conversations

**Week 1: Impact Update**
- [ ] Share event results (funds raised)
- [ ] Post event highlights on social media
- [ ] Send survey for feedback

**Week 2: Continued Engagement**
- [ ] Share how event funds will be used
- [ ] Invite to next event
- [ ] Offer volunteer opportunities

**Month 1: Full Circle**
- [ ] Report on early impact
- [ ] Feature donor story
- [ ] Begin planning next year

---

## Template 6: Upgrade/Stretch Gift Workflow

### 90-Day Cultivation Process

**Days 1-30: Deepening Relationship**
- [ ] Schedule qualification meeting
- [ ] Share organizational case for support
- [ ] Identify donor interests/passions
- [ ] Arrange program site visit

**Days 31-60: Specific Opportunity**
- [ ] Present tailored giving opportunity
- [ ] Provide naming rights/recognition options
- [ ] Share financial projections
- [ ] Introduce program leadership

**Days 61-90: Proposal & Close**
- [ ] Submit written proposal
- [ ] Schedule follow-up meeting
- [ ] Address questions/concerns
- [ ] Request the gift
- [ ] Negotiate terms if needed

**Post-Gift: Enhanced Stewardship**
- [ ] Execute gift agreement
- [ ] Implement recognition plan
- [ ] Schedule quarterly updates
- [ ] Assign dedicated relationship manager

---

## Quick Reference: Communication Frequency by Donor Level

| Donor Level | Annual Touches | Personal Contacts | Events |
|-------------|----------------|-------------------|---------|
| **$1-$250** | 6-8 | 0-1 | Open events |
| **$251-$999** | 8-12 | 2-3 | 1-2 per year |
| **$1,000-$4,999** | 12-18 | 4-6 | 2-3 per year |
| **$5,000-$24,999** | 18-24 | 6-8 | 3-4 per year |
| **$25,000+** | 24+ | 12+ | All events |

---

## Essential Stewardship Best Practices

✅ **Acknowledge within 48 hours**
✅ **Thank donors 7 times for every ask**
✅ **Use multiple channels (mail, email, phone, in-person)**
✅ **Personalize whenever possible**
✅ **Show impact, not just activities**
✅ **Track all interactions in your CRM**
✅ **Set automatic reminders for follow-up**
✅ **Segment donors for relevant messaging**

Would you like me to customize any of these templates for your specific organization or donor base?
